Title: Package Dependencies and External APIs
Content:
## Referenced Packages (with existing API References)
1. **Cyrena.Core** — Foundational contracts (IAssistantMode, IAssistantPlugin, IChatMessageService, IKernelController, CyrenaBuilder, CyrenaKernelBuilder, etc.)
2. **Cyrena.Extensa.Core** — Extension system (IExtension, Extension base class, ExtensionInfo, Dependency resolution)
3. **Cyrena.Persistence.Core** — Persistence abstractions (IStore<T>, ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder, StoreExtensions)
4. **Cyrena.Components.Core** — Blazor UI contracts (IDisplayService, IShortcut, IToolbarComponent, KernelComponentBase)

## Additional Packages (no API References provided)
1. **FSharp.Compiler.Service** — F# compilation API (FSharpChecker, FSharpAsync, FSharpDiagnosticSeverity)
2. **FSharp.Core** — F# runtime (FSharpOption<T>, FSharpFunc)
3. **Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web** — Blazor component base classes
4. **Microsoft.SemanticKernel** — Kernel functions, plugins (referenced transitively via Cyrena.Core)
5. **BootstrapBlazor** — UI components (Dialog, ToastContainer, etc.) — referenced transitively via Cyrena.Components.Core

## Key External APIs Used
- FSharpChecker.Create() — F# compiler instance
- FSharpAsync.StartAsTask() — Run F# async from C#
- AssemblyLoadContext — Assembly isolation (NOT security boundary)
- Path.GetFullPath + StartsWith check — Path traversal prevention
- System.Text.Json — JSON serialization for arguments
